items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Lyle used to be on those Latin bands that we played.

ctx.x: Yeah, Chick was on it, Richard Davis. So yeah, like I said, this is indispensible. Lyle Atkinson on bass. Bobby Capers.
Yeah, I know Lyle. Lyle used to be on those Latin bands that we played. Yeah, Lyle Atkinson. I wonder if he’s still around?
I can find out and let you know tomorrow.
